sequence_plan.report_mode: atomic status updates; create-only at plan start

grade_contract.notes: The grader validates PROFILE_F1_SOURCE_AMENDMENT_R4.json and WARM_F1_ORDER_EXPECTATION_AMENDMENT_R1.json at their canonical packet paths; it has no amendment CLI flag. It independently checks the exact clean amended training source commit and added cache-reader pin, while its declared trainer file list does not include distillation_cache.py.

resource_contract.gpu_lock: exclusive local GPU admission required; no concurrent GPU worker

runtime_contract.basis: Frozen R1 eight-hour ceiling; root recomputes remaining authorized wall time and complete-phase projection from measured profiles before admission.

required_root_gates_before_launch: F0 actual-parent/shared-normalization/finite-output parity remains passing; rerun F1 under the exact R4 source and order-expectation amendments and require its paired setup, normalization, membership, and finite output parity gates to pass.

Verify the exact WARM_F1_ORDER_EXPECTATION_AMENDMENT_R1 digest; retain the R1 F1 parent-order hash as ancestry evidence while checking the canonical seed-4 child train order and unchanged F1 valid order.
Verify grader source/plan integration pins both amendments and its final schema v3 before executing the paired-grade step.
Verify source commit 81f47a3fd94e4209e47b1f3815af2907e8f0b5d7 is clean and all 41 frozen source pins plus the added cache-reader pin match.
Recompute full four-fit + four-export + grade phase projection from measured warm profiles and existing cost evidence; do not truncate the panel.
Bind an effective timeout not exceeding both remaining authorized stage budget and 28800 seconds.
Check all four run directories, checkpoint targets, prediction NPY/sidecar targets, grader output, sequence report, and partial/temp paths for collisions before execution.
Rehash cache/valid_targets.npz against the frozen digest before grading; retain all fit and export outputs under the source-qualified run IDs.
Run scripts/kaggle_sequence.py from the project root with the listed environment and an exclusive single-worker GPU lock.

evaluation.fixed_mixture: 90% matched zero-history control + 10% history treatment, blend before official clipping; no coefficient search.

execution: Preparation only: no fits, exports, grader, datasets, arrays, or GPU work were run by this actor.

runner_invocation.environment: Use the environment object above for the whole sequential worker; the runner inherits it for every child process.
runner_invocation.argv_resolution: The runner substitutes sys.executable for each {python} token; fit argv changes only the trainer entrypoint, while prediction export argv matches the frozen plan.

root_actual_parity_update.F0: Root reports actual-parent, normalization-sharing, and finite-output parity passed for both arms over two complete sequences; maximum output error was zero.
root_actual_parity_update.F1: The first R4 setup/parity attempt failed before parent/child output comparison because the frozen R1 train-order hash described the seed-3 parent, while the new F1 child uses seed 4. The order-expectation amendment preserves the parent hash and binds the canonical seed-4 child order. Root owns the F1 rerun.
root_actual_parity_update.claim_limit: Parity is a setup check, not a quality fit or score comparison.
